display.purpose: Oswald tracked caps; wordmark, hero statements, the Horizon piece. Always uppercase.

body.purpose: Default reading text, 14px/1.55, measure capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Instrument labels, rail group labels, divider labels. Oswald caps or Public Sans tracked caps for field labels.

shadows.name: overlay-day
shadows.purpose: Dialog panels only — the system's single real shadow (day phase).

shadows.name: focus-ring-day
shadows.purpose: Focus-is-light ring on fields and choices (day phase).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve: exponential ease-out. Light rises, never bounces.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: State transitions: hover, focus, border shifts.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Larger state moves: switch knob, phase accents.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: The authored cue-up entrance: dialog rise, band stagger (45ms per band).

breakpoints.name: shell-fold
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the navigation rail folds into a horizontal strip above the canvas.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one lit control: solid flat cobalt, no gradient, no glow. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #ffffff; background: var(--action, #0a2bff); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-strong, #0a22d6); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a2bff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline-outline action; hover lights the outline cobalt instead of filling.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--ink, #121218); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cfcdd9); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #0a2bff); color: var(--accent, #0a2bff); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--bg-band, #faf9fc); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a2bff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Borderless cobalt text; hover lays a quiet cobalt tonal band behind.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--accent, #0a2bff); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent-soft-bg, rgb(10 43 255 / 0.08)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a2bff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline instrument; focus arrives as a cobalt ring of light, never elevation.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 34px; width: 260px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #121218); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cfcdd9); border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #626274); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #626274); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #0a2bff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ring, rgb(10 43 255 / 0.22)); }

components.name: Go Badge
components.description: Small lit pill for status; tracked caps with tabular numerals. Rose variant signals AI presence.
components.css: .ds-badge-go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2.5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--go-bg, rgb(10 43 255 / 0.08)); color: var(--go, #0a2bff); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A matte band bounded by hairlines, never shadow; hover strengthens the hairline.
components.html:
Morning rounds

Three follow-ups captured. The light carries the state — never shadow, never noise.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e6e4ec); border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #cfcdd9); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--ink, #121218); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink, #121218); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Quiet text row over a hairline; the active tab's horizon lights in cobalt.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e6e4ec); } .ds-tab { appearance: none; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3, #626274); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #121218); } .ds-tab--active { color: var(--ink, #121218); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a2bff); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a2bff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: One lit panel over a dimmed stage; carries the system's only real shadow and the cue-up entrance.
components.html:
Delete this note?

This removes the note and its links. The automation that reads it will pause.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(440px, 100%); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #121218); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cfcdd9); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 24px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px rgb(5 5 6 / 0.18); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); animation: ds-dialog-in 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-dialog-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); filter: blur(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; } } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0; font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 12px 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-2, #40404e); } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background: var(--action, #0a2bff); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-primary:hover { background: var(--action-strong, #0a22d6); } .ds-dialog-ghost { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent, #0a2bff); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent-soft-bg, rgb(10 43 255 / 0.08)); }

narrative.overview: twodb's interface is a stage at first light. Surfaces are a horizon — quiet matte bands bounded by hairline rules — and every state change arrives as light rising: cobalt for structure and action, rose for the AI's presence. Light is the only chrome. The system refuses the category's gray-cards-and-drop-shadows default: no gradient fills on controls, no glow, no colored shadows, no ornamental decoration. Depth is tonal, not dimensional. The world runs in two phases: day (default working surface) and night (depthless black, via [data-phase="night"]), one semantic token set resolving both. Density is calm and slightly condensed with protected negative space; type pairs Public Sans with Oswald tracked caps (the cue register); motion is a single exponential ease-out with one authored cue-up entrance; fine fractal-noise grain at low opacity gives large fields a matte tooth.
keyCharacteristics: Two phases (day default / night via [data-phase="night"]), one semantic token set.
One lit control per view: only the primary action carries solid color (flat cobalt).
Elevation = hairline borders + tonal bands; the dialog overlay carries the only real shadow.
Cue register: Oswald tracked caps for labels; tabular numerals for data.
Fine grain (0.06 day multiply / 0.08 night screen) over large fields — matte, never glossy.
The cobalt→rose sweep (--wash) is identity material only: the Horizon foundation piece and future brand moments.

rules.name: The Flat Calm Rule
rules.body: No gradient fills on any control. Primary actions are solid cobalt (--action). The cobalt→rose sweep (--wash) survives only as identity material in the Horizon foundation piece and future brand moments — never on buttons, fields, cards, or badges. (User-pinned, dial B.)

rules.name: The One Lit Control Rule
rules.body: Only the primary action carries solid color. Everything else is hairline, tonal, or text. If two controls on a screen are solid-filled, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means go/act; rose means the AI is present. Never trade them.

rules.name: The Cue Register Rule
rules.body: Oswald is caps-and-tracked or nothing. It labels and marks; it never sets sentences, body copy, or button text.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any numeral that can change value (times, counts, live data) sets tabular-nums. Proportional figures are for prose only.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The dialog overlay owns the only real shadow in the system. Everywhere else, elevation is a hairline plus a tonal band. A new shadow anywhere is a finding, not a feature.

rules.name: The Focus Is Light Rule
rules.body: Focus and validation states arrive as rings of light (3px ring at 22%/35% accent opacity) plus a border shift — never as elevation.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: 1px or nothing. If a boundary needs more than a hairline plus a tonal shift, the grouping is wrong — re-band, don't thicken.

rules.name: The Air Is Load-Bearing Rule
rules.body: Do not compress spacing to fit more on screen. The calm comes from the rests between bands; remove content before removing space.

dos: Do write components against semantic tokens (--bg, --ink, --line, --accent, --action) so both phases resolve for free; flip phases with [data-phase="night"], never with hard-coded colors.
Do keep exactly one solid cobalt control per view — the primary action (The One Lit Control Rule).
Do use rose only where the AI is present (The Two Lights Rule).
Do elevate with hairlines and tonal bands: --line → --line-strong, --bg-band → --bg-band-strong.
Do set data, times, and counts in tabular numerals (.tw-tnum).
Do keep grain at 0.06 (day, multiply) / 0.08 (night, screen) over large fields — matte tooth, never glossy (user-pinned).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: all transitions and the cue-up entrance collapse.
donts: Don't put gradient fills on any control — primary actions are solid cobalt; --wash is identity material for the Horizon piece and brand moments only (The Flat Calm Rule, user-pinned).
Don't add glow, colored shadows, or drop shadows; the dialog overlay owns the only real shadow (The One Shadow Rule, user-pinned).
Don't set Oswald in sentence case or for body/button text (The Cue Register Rule).
Don't use rose for ordinary actions or cobalt for AI output.
Don't compress spacing to fit more; remove content before removing air (The Air Is Load-Bearing Rule).
Don't introduce new easing curves or bouncy motion — one exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); light rises, never bounces.
Don't add Tailwind or CSS-in-JS to packages/ui; the token contract is plain CSS custom properties consumed as source.
